labeling: A/B/C method (same as layer 1, ai/docs/i3_eval_freeze.md section 2). Labelers A and B (Claude) linked each of the 978 items of eval/labels_i3_v1.json (raw_name = menu print) to catalog_v2_2_service keys independently, without the matcher, the extraction pipeline or an LLM API (web search only to check that an expression exists). Raw agreement: 954/978 items, 656/675 lines. Most differences were the same new product under two keys or display names; after mapping those to one product: 975/978 items, 673/675 lines. Adjudicator C (Claude) picked one canonical definition per new product (brand owner's English name, consistent age_years/edition_name; 20 of 63 agreed new products had differing A/B definitions), decided the 2 remaining line disagreements, and applied the convention answers provisionally (three-product both:, partly identifiable lines -> unknown, brand-only lines -> brand default product as in match_gold_final_v1). Items left for 박진우 are listed in review_for_jinwoo.md; his review is pending.
catalog: ai/catalog/catalog_v2_service.json (catalog_v2_2_service, keys); new: products are not in the catalog. new_products.brand = catalog brand key when the brand exists (match_eval.load_catalog looks brands up by key), otherwise the new brand's English name; brand_name = display name of the brand
